scope: research decision engine only; no production imports, changes, orders, merge or deployment

universe.cohort_rule: Top 20 by December 2020 observed quote turnover, among archived USDT symbols with >=28 daily bars that month. Exclude stablecoin bases and leveraged UP/DOWN/BULL/BEAR products. Fixed ex-ante cohort; no later winners added. All historical archived symbols are enumerated, including delisted ones. This is a bounded investable cohort, not a whole-market claim.
universe.missing_prices: Never impute/rank a missing asset. No future last-date liquidation. Missing held quotes fail the replay closed. Listings are first-observed tradable-bar lower bounds; delisting notices require published and effective times. Unverified administrative dates remain explicitly unverified.

data.perpetual_gate: Require contract-specific trade and mark OHLC, actual timestamped funding, listing/delisting notices and historical maintenance/liquidation schedule. Missing evidence blocks perpetual and short scoring; spot prices cannot substitute for perpetual prices.

accounting.fill: A completed daily close D is available D+1 00:01 UTC; fill at first subsequent captured 4h open, D+1 04:00 UTC. A 4h close signal is available close+60s and fills at next captured 4h open. Signal row to fill row = 2 bars. Stress adds one 4h bar to the entire target stream.
accounting.exposure: Unlevered 1x or CASH only. No ETF, TP, stop, cooldown or leverage during baseline search.
accounting.sizing: Fixed units between decision changes. On entry solve post-cost notional = NAV; spot holding has no funding. No drift rebalancing absent a decision change.
accounting.fold_exit: Charge close exit on final 4h bar of each calendar year and evaluation window. Warmup only uses observations strictly before the first test trade.

experiment_schema.D: Blocked until perpetual data gate passes; signed-accounting tests may run but no fabricated performance.
experiment_schema.E: Only independently qualifying prior OOS family champions can enter an ensemble; require >=2 members. Cash otherwise. No blend of failed baselines.

evolution.selection: Prior calendar year inner validation only; feasibility-first Pareto nondominated sorting and deterministic crowding. No outer OOS or forward data enter mutation or selection. Each origin resets populations independently. Origin 2026 is final nomination only; 2026 outcomes are not read.

selection.baseline_qualifies: Stitched prior outer OOS: positive CAGR and both cost/delay stresses, MDD<=35%, Sharpe>=0.75, >=75% strictly positive annual folds. This modest gate permits further research layers, not main-goal PASS.
selection.family_champion: Feasible Pareto then smallest MDD, highest Calmar, highest Sharpe, highest CAGR, lower turnover, lexical ID. Development feasibility: positive CAGR, MDD<=35%, both stresses positive.
selection.finalists: Freeze A high-return diagnostic, B robust (MDD<=25%), C compromise (MDD<=35%) using only final-origin development Pareto. A prioritizes DD<=20%, then DD<=30%, then Calmar/Sharpe/CAGR; B highest CAGR; C highest Calmar. If no feasible candidate, nominee is null; retain explicitly rejected diagnostic representatives rather than relabeling them feasible.

neighbors.rule: Every immediately adjacent enum value of each numeric/boolean/cadence parameter, one coordinate at a time; no favorable subsampling
neighbors.pass: At least75% have positive validation CAGR and MDD<=35%; median CAGR>=75% of parent positive CAGR. Pure validation evidence; OOS neighbors are descriptive only.

ablations: For each frozen family champion: A remove breadth and remove slow confirmation separately; B remove volatility ranking and isolate each 30/90/180/365 lookback; C remove intraday entry (daily regime alone), then remove daily regime. Test baseline components, not extra risk overlays. Never use these OOS contrasts to revise a nominee.

deepseek.input: Only schema and sanitized prior-year development candidate configurations and metrics
deepseek.output: Exactly four candidate parameter objects for the current family; strict no-extra-key/type/enum validation. No code, paths, tools or evaluator changes.
deepseek.fallback: Deterministic adjacent parameter mutations when key/API/valid JSON unavailable. Never read arbitrary dotenv files or expose keys. Never transmit OOS, future or sealed results.

forward.rule: Previously inspected repository history is not a new seal. Freeze nominees before any prospective data acquisition. This run must return REJECT for validated-winner claims when sealed/venue evidence is missing.
